# GOLDEN BASELINE — replace with a live Linux /metrics capture (scripts/capture-golden-baseline.sh)
# Seed set of statically-known base metric families so the parity gate runs on
# any platform. The real baseline (incl. dynamic per-CPU / per-field families)
# is captured on Linux before any procfs sampler is retired (design §6.2).
# TYPE cpu_usage counter
cpu_usage{cpu="0",state="user"} 0
cpu_usage_rate{cpu="0",state="user",percentile="99"} 0
# TYPE cpu_load gauge
cpu_load{window="1"} 0
# TYPE memory_MemFree gauge
memory_MemFree{} 0
# TYPE memory_MemTotal gauge
memory_MemTotal{} 0
# TYPE network_receive_bytes counter
network_receive_bytes{iface="eth0"} 0
# TYPE network_transmit_bytes counter
network_transmit_bytes{iface="eth0"} 0
# TYPE disk_read_bytes counter
disk_read_bytes{device="sda"} 0
# TYPE disk_write_bytes counter
disk_write_bytes{device="sda"} 0
# TYPE psi_cpu_some_avg10 gauge
psi_cpu_some_avg10{} 0
# TYPE softirq_TIMER counter
softirq_TIMER{} 0
# TYPE tcp_rtt_us gauge
tcp_rtt_us{port="443"} 0
# TYPE tcp_retransmits counter
tcp_retransmits{port="443"} 0
